segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: ROOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOAR!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: It didn't sound like a dog. It sounded like an avalanche of thunder ripping through the heavens!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The entire five-hundred-foot tower shuddered to its very foundation! Dust and icicles rained down from the iron rafters!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The Clockmaker froze mid-sentence, his eyes darting upward in utter shock.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: What in St. Nick's name is that?!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: CRRRRRRRRR-AAAAAASH!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The massive stained-glass skylight four hundred feet above the clock tower shattered into a million glittering shards of colored glass!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Falling straight out of the snowy night sky, surrounded by swirling clouds of red-and-white peppermint canvas and roaring propane flame, was a shadow.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A colossal, white, muscular shadow.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The creature landed in the center of the iron platform with an earth-shattering crash that bent the steel girders and sent the Clockwork Praetorians staggering!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: It was Titan.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Except... Titan didn't look like a normal bulldog anymore.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He was standing on all four massive, tree-trunk paws. He was already the size of a grizzly bear—easily ten feet tall at the shoulders, his white coat gleaming like fresh glacier ice, his black freckles standing out like war paint!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Clutched in his giant front paw was Granny's hand-stitched burlap pouch.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan looked at the soldiers holding you. He looked at Pip's empty hat lying on the grating.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A low, deep, volcanic growl rumbled in Titan's massive chest, so powerful it rattled your teeth inside your skull.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Without breaking eye contact with the Clockmaker, the giant bulldog reached into the pouch, pulled out another of Granny's Courage Nubbies, and popped it into his mouth.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: CHOMP.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You swear, right before your very eyes...

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: HE GOT BIGGER.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: His muscular shoulders swelled to the size of steam engines! His broad chest expanded until he stood twenty feet tall, his little docked nub tail buzzing with fierce, unstoppable protective fury!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The Clockmaker backed away, his obsidian watch trembling in his hand.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: W-What is that thing?!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: the Clockmaker stammered in horror.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan looked down at the Clockmaker with glowing, fearless brown eyes. When he spoke, his voice was a thunderous, room-shaking roar that shook the very gears of the universe:

segments.speaker: titan
segments.text: I AM TITAN. AND NOBODY TOUCHES MY FRIEND.
